summary: Independent E2E validation of Bizum-only booking flow for Slayed by Joana17. All backend and frontend checks pass. 6/6 pytest tests pass (payment method validation, Box Braids Mujer pricing 72€/36€/36€, Boho category 75€/37.50€/37.50€, notified=true with email null, extras_detail with qty, earnings recording only 36€ deposit). Frontend UI shows only Bizum (no card/cash), service selector distinguishes 'Box Braids · Mujer' vs 'Box Braids · Hombre' without concatenation, total 72€, señal Bizum 36€, resto 36€. Test data (bookings + earnings) cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~995 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, bookings, payments, media, email) for maintainability.
pay_label_for still contains legacy 'online' and 'cash' branches even though POST /api/bookings now rejects both; harmless but dead code.
cancel flow deletes the booking row (hard delete) after sending cancellation email - this loses audit trail; consider status='cancelled' soft-delete for admin history.
test_credentials: Admin: joana@slayedbyjoana17.com / Joana17_Slayed! (login works via /api/auth/login with httpOnly cookie).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 test bookings and 1 earning record (Box Braids Mujer, Boho, earnings test). All cleaned up after tests (bookings via admin cancel PATCH which hard-deletes; earnings cleaned via direct MongoDB delete on client name TEST_*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bizum-only booking flow is fully validated. If retesting, run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_bookings_bizum.py -v. Payment methods 'online' and 'cash' correctly return 400. Data-testids used: booking-service-select, booking-length-select, booking-size-select, booking-extra-<id>, extra-plus-<id>, extra-qty-<id>, booking-total-amount, booking-pay-bizum, booking-remaining-amount, booking-form-submit-button. Service labels displayed as 'Name · Mujer' or 'Name · Hombre' (with middle dot).
